title: Delhi HC issues notice on LiveLaw’s challenge to automated content blocking under IT Rules
summary:
The Delhi HC has sought responses from the Centre and Meta on LiveLaw’s challenge to automated content blocking under the IT Rules after Instagram restricted its reels on Supreme Court proceedings.

The post Delhi HC issues notice on LiveLaw’s challenge to automated content blocking under IT Rules appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: The Delhi High Court has asked the Indian government and Meta for their replies to LiveLaw’s petition challenging the use of automated content‑blocking provisions under the IT Rules.
